_comment: DWS IQ 6 — Google-managed MCP example config.
Copy the entries you actually need into your local .mcp.json. The exact
Google-managed server URLs come from the canonical catalog at
do not treat the hostnames below as stable, replace them with the
current endpoint shown in the Google docs for each server.
Authentication is Cloud IAM, not a static API key. Populate
${GOOGLE_ID_TOKEN} at session start with, for example:
See docs/MCP_CONFIGURATION.md section 4 for the full guidance,
including the DWS prefer-Google-managed rule and the EU sovereignty
checklist before pointing these servers at customer data.

google-cloud-run._comment: Cloud Run management — replaces the retired DWS cloudrun-mcp.

google-bigquery._comment: BigQuery query/analysis — use for emissions and analytics datasets.

google-cloud-logging._comment: Read service logs without scripting gcloud logging read.

google-cloud-storage._comment: GCS object access — e.g. LWM checkpoints, exported reports.

google-maps-grounding-lite._comment: Routing / weather / POI for SiteSense and construction agents. Non-sensitive inputs only — Maps may route outside the EU.
